hero.title: Gukurura TikTok — Kurura Amashusho Nta Akamenyetso · Bwite
hero.subtitle: Shyira urubuto hanyuma ukure mu isegonda 3. Ishusho mu bwiza bw'umuhanzi ko kare, nta kamera nta gusobanura bushya — gukurura TikTok ku buntu kuri interineti nta kwiyandikisha nta porogaramu.

cta.title: Witeguye Gukurura?
cta.text: Tangira gukurura amashusho yawe ukunda ya TikTok nta akamenyetso mu bwiza bw'umwimeri. Nta kwiyandikisha nta gushyiraho bikenewe.

common.independent: ni serivisi yigenga kandi nta mibanire, nta gusezereza, cyangwa nta isano na TikTok cyangwa ByteDance Ltd.
common.otherToolsLead: Ibyo wese ushobora kubika gukur TikTok, buri bwoko bufite igikoresho cabo bwite.

footer.tagline: Uburyo bwihuse kandi butekanye bwo gukurura amashusho, amafoto, n'inkuru za TikTok nta akamenyetso. 100% bwite, nta kwiyandikisha.

steps.title: Kurura mu Nyito 3
steps.lead: Intambwe eshatu. Bizakugendera akanya gatari arenga amasegonda 10.

video.intro: Bika iyo ari yo yose ishusho ya TikTok ukoresheje {t} — ubwiza bw'umwimeri, nta akamenyetso, bivuye kuri seriveri za TikTok bijya kuri device yawe.
steps: Shaka ishusho ushaka kubika muri porogaramu cyangwa kuri tiktok.com.
Kanda Share → Copy link. Amahuza make ya vm.tiktok.com na vt.tiktok.com na yo akora.
Shyira urubuto hejuru hanyuma ukande Search, ubwongo hitamo ubwoko bwawe.

converter.intro: Hindura TikTok mu bwoko ukeneye ukoresheje {t}. Nta gusobanura bushya nkurw'e — dukura dosiye y'umwimeri tuyikugeza mu bwoko bwatoranijwe.
steps: Koresha Share → Copy link muri porogaramu cyangwa kuri aderesi.
Shyira urubuto hejuru hanyuma ukande Search kugira ngo usuzume icyegeranyo.
Hitamo ubwoko bwo kwegeranya hanyuma dosiye ijya kuri device yawe.

photo.intro: Kurura amafoto, ama-carousel, n'ibikupu bya TikTok mu bwiza buhanitse ukoresheje {t}. Buri shusho itangwa nk'ubwoko JPG bwuzuye.
steps: Fungura ifoto, carousel cyangwa slideshow ushaka kubika.
Shyira hejuru, ukande Search, ubike buri shusho ku giti cyayo.

audio.intro: Kuramo kandi ubike ijwi rya TikTok ukoresheje {t} — umuziki, amajwi, n'amajwi y'umwimeri yatanzwe nk'MP3.
steps: Share → Copy link kuri ishusho ufite ijwi ushaka.
Hitamo MP3 hanyuma ijwi ribikwa kuri device yawe.

text.intro: Bona imyandikire, ibisobanuro, n'ibindi ku ishusho iyo ari yo yose ya TikTok ukoresheje {t}. Koporora inyandiko cyangwa ukure nk'ubwoko TXT cyangwa SRT.
steps: Koporora inyandiko cyangwa ukure nk'ubwoko TXT / SRT bufite amasegonda.

device.intro: {t} — amabwiriza intambwe ku ntambwe yo gukurura amashusho ya TikTok kuri device yawe, hamwe n'aho buri dosiye igenda n'uko wakemura ibibazo bisanzwe.
steps: Shyira hejuru, ukande Search, ubike dosiye kuri device yawe.

pro.intro: {t} — igikoresho gikoresha browser, bwite. Nta gushyiraho, nta kwiyandikisha, gikora kuri buri browser nziza.
steps: Nta gushyiraho bikenewe — gikora muri browser yawe.
Shyira urubuto rwa TikTok cyangwa koresha amabuto yatanzwe.
Igisubizo gikorwa ako kanya kandi kigiteguye gukoreshwa.

toolFaq: Yego. 100% bwite, nta kwiyandikisha, nta kwiyandikisha kenshi.
Oya. Gikora kuri buri browser nziza kuri iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac na Linux.
Icyo uyihe umuhanzi — ntarenga, ntarenga. Ntarahuzu cyangwa twongere ubwiza.
Ntabwo tubika icyo ukura. Dosiye zijya bivuye kuri TikTok zijya kuri device yawe.

blogBody.intro: {t} — umurongo mwiza, ukora. Ibyo ukeneye kumenya byose, nta magambo adasobanutse.
sections: Uyu murongo usobanura {t} mu ntambwe zoroshye ushobora gukurikira kuri buri device.
Tangira ukoporora urubuto rwa TikTok ushaka gukoresha (Share → Copy link). Rushyire muri porogaramu hejuru hanyuma ukande Search.
Koresha urubuto rwa porogaramu bw'umwimeri igihe ubishoboye, gumeza ishusho ku mugaragaro, kandi umuhe umuhanzi agaciro mu gihe wayisangira.
Niba gukurura bitatangiye, menya ko ishusho iherereye ku mugaragaro kandi ko urubuto rugarukira ku kintu runaka, atari ku mwirondoro.

howto.intro: Kurura amashusho ya TikTok nta akamenyetso mu ntambwe eshatu zoroshye — kuri iPhone, Android na PC.
sections: Kanda Share → Copy link muri porogaramu ya TikTok.
Shyira urubuto hejuru hanyuma ukande Search.
Hitamo HD Video, MP3 cyangwa amashusho hanyuma dosiye ijya kuri device yawe.

about.intro: {site} ni gukurura TikTok bwite kandi gidengenga. Dukora ko kubika ibintu byo ku mugaragaro mu bwiza bw'umwimeri byoroshye.
sections: Guha buri wese uburyo bwihuse, bw'ibanga, bwite bwo kubika ibikoresho byye n'amashusho yo ku mugaragaro, n'emeza ryo.

contact.intro: Ibibazo, ibitekerezo cyangwa icyifuzo cya DMCA? Vugana n'itsinda rya {site}.

faq.intro: Ibisubizo ku bibazo bisanzwe ku gukurura TikTok nta akamenyetso.
sections: Gukurura ibintu byo ku mugaragaro kugira ngo bikoreshwe bwite birahwitse; wubaha copyright hanyuma umuhe umuhanzi agaciro.

privacy-policy.intro: {site} ihabwa ibanga ryawe agaciro. Uyu mutwe usobanura ibyo dukora n'ibyo tudakora.
sections: Ntabwo tubika amashusho, amateka cyangwa ubushakashatsi.

terms-of-service.intro: Koresha {site} bivuze ko wemera ibi bisobanuro.
sections: Koresha serivisi gusa ku bikoresho ufite uburenganzira bwo kubika.

dmca.intro: {site} ihabwa uburenganzira bwa intelectuel hanyuma isubiza ku byitetewe bya DMCA byemewe.
sections: Ohereza kuri support@tiktmeta.com hamwe na URL n'ikimenyetso cy'ukuri kw'ubwite.

cookie-policy.intro: {site} ikoresha cookies kugira ngo urupapuro rukomeze gukora kandi rukomeye.
sections: Ushobora kuzima cookies muri browser yawe.

faqPage: Gukurura amashusho ya TikTok ni bwite?
Yego. TiktMeta ni 100% bwite nta kwiyandikisha nta kwiyandikisha.
Oya. Gikora kuri buri browser nziza kuri iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac na Linux.
Icyo uyihe umuhanzi — ntarahuzu cyangwa twongere ubwiza.
Ntabwo tubika icyo ukura; dosiye zijya bivuye kuri TikTok zijya kuri device yawe.
Nshobora gukurura amashusho y'ibanga cyangwa yakuwe?
Oya. Dukoresha ibintu TikTok itanga ku mugaragaro gusa.
